bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 30 June 2026' (the filing also separately shows a discrete '01 April to 30 June' 3-month column, not used here to keep the series consistent); flagged via the _cumulative suffix. Standalone/Solo basis (the filing's plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)', distinct from its separately-presented 'Consolidated' statements). Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2026.pdf) is a scanned/OCR document; its embedded pdftotext text layer was badly corrupted (systematic digit substitution and garbled multi-digit figures). All figures below were sourced via direct visual inspection of 400dpi page renders of the standalone Balance Sheet (source page 7) and Profit and Loss Account (source page 9), both independently verified fully internally consistent (balance sheet ties to the taka: Total Liabilities 399,019,710,461 + Total Equity 30,390,623,951 = Total Assets 429,410,334,412; each equity reserve line sums exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity for both columns; Profit before tax 3,031,839,491 - Provision for tax 672,745,212 = Net Profit after tax 2,359,094,279, matching the filing's own EPS of 2.04). Cross-check: this filing's own comparative 'as at 31 December 2025' balance-sheet column (Total Assets 398,829,082,972; Total Liabilities 368,667,063,151; Total Equity 30,162,019,821) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2025_Q4.json figures exactly (398829 / 368667 / 30162 BDT_million, consistent to rounding) -- no discrepancy for FY2025 year-end. RESTATEMENT NOTE: this report's own comparative column for Jan-Jun 2025 is explicitly labeled '[previous period's figure restated]' on the deferred tax and EPS lines, showing PAT of BDT 2,142.59mn / EPS 1.86 for that period -- materially different from the BDT 1,151.59mn / EPS 1.04 contemporaneously reported in the bank's own original H1 2025 filing (see bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2025_Q2.json, sourced from the original half_yearly_report_2025.pdf, which is retained as authoritative per project convention; this restated comparative was NOT used for any 2025 record). The filing's discrete '01 April to 30 June 2026' column (Q2-only, not cumulative) shows Net Profit after tax of BDT 1,146.56mn and EPS 0.99, included here for reference only, not as a structured line item, to keep the series' cumulative convention consistent.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF pages 7 (Balance Sheet, Un-audited) and 9 (Profit and Loss Account, Un-audited), 'Un-audited Financial Statements for the half year ended June 30, 2026'. pdftotext -layout text layer was badly corrupted (systematic OCR digit-substitution errors); figures verified via direct visual inspection of 400dpi page renders instead of the text layer.
